display_long_description:
RealityCheck is a powerful and easy-to-use VR timer, interval timer, countdown timer, and stopwatch for focused work, training, and workouts – especially in immersive environments like virtual reality.

In VR, it is easy to lose track of time. RealityCheck works as your reliable clock, timer, and stopwatch, helping you stay in control of your sessions and reminding you exactly when it matters.

RealityCheck includes a 7-day free trial. If you like the app, you can unlock the full version afterwards with a one-time in-app purchase.

Create custom intervals, use a flexible countdown, or run a precise stopwatch to structure your routines and stay in the flow without distractions. With saved plans, you can quickly access and reuse your training sessions anytime.

Whether you are doing table tennis training, workouts, focus sessions, or productivity tasks in VR – RealityCheck is your all-in-one training timer and focus timer to stay consistent and efficient.

Features:
• Fully customizable interval timer
• Adjustable countdown timer
• Integrated stopwatch with optional tracking in statistics
• Save and load training and time plans
• Backup and restore for plans and statistics
• Battery-aware notifications with precise alerts
• Advanced statistics: weekly, monthly, and yearly overview
• Multiple selectable alarm sounds
• Clean dark mode design
• Simple and intuitive interface

Take control of your time with a powerful VR timer, stopwatch, and countdown tool – with RealityCheck.
